scripts.format:check: cargo fmt --all --check && npm --prefix apps/desktop exec prettier -- --check "tools/*.mjs" package.json && npm --prefix apps/desktop run format:check
scripts.check: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && npm --prefix apps/desktop run check && npm --prefix integrations/obsidian-bridge run check
scripts.test: npm run test:tools && cargo test --workspace --all-targets && npm --prefix apps/desktop test && npm --prefix integrations/obsidian-bridge test && node tools/verify-s-fixture.mjs
scripts.test:tools: node --test tools/format-fixture-manifest.test.mjs tools/format-worker-dependency-policy.test.mjs tools/package-format-worker.test.mjs tools/resource-stability-analysis.test.mjs tools/soak-baseline-audit.test.mjs tools/p2-exit-status.test.mjs tools/p2-local-fault-gates.test.mjs tools/p2-hosted-readiness.test.mjs tools/p2-hosted-evidence.test.mjs tools/platform-path-evidence.test.mjs tools/report-platform-path-failure.test.mjs tools/platform-matrix-analysis.test.mjs tools/platform-matrix-runner.test.mjs tools/platform-matrix-archive.test.mjs tools/phase-2-external-gates.test.mjs tools/p2-data-safety-audit.test.mjs tools/phase-2-exit-gates.test.mjs tools/schema-contracts.test.mjs
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/desktop run tauri:build && npm --prefix integrations/obsidian-bridge run build
scripts.ci: npm run format:check && npm run check && npm test && npm run build
